name: offering_memorandum
description: Key facts from a multifamily offering memorandum. One entry per document. Values are spread across the summary, financial and rent sections; take the figure the OM presents as current, not a projection, unless the field says otherwise.

property_name.name: Property Name
property_name.original: Name of the property being offered.
property_name.description: Extract the name of the property being offered as text.

address.name: Street Address
address.original: Street address of the property, without city and state.
address.description: Extract the property's street address without the city or state. Return the address as text.

city.name: City
city.description: Extract the property's city as text.

state.name: State
state.description: Extract the property's state as a two-letter state code.

zip_code.name: ZIP Code
zip_code.description: Extract the ZIP code as a string.

county.name: County
county.original: County the property is in, if the OM states it. null otherwise.
county.description: Extract the county the property is in if the OM states it. Return null otherwise.

submarket.name: Submarket
submarket.original: Submarket or neighbourhood the OM places the property in, if named.
submarket.description: Extract the submarket or neighbourhood the OM places the property in, if named. Return it as text.

broker_name.name: Brokerage
broker_name.original: The brokerage firm presenting the offering.
broker_name.description: Extract the name of the brokerage firm presenting the offering as text.

units.name: Number of Units
units.original: Total unit count, as a number.
units.description: Extract the total unit count as a number. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

year_built.name: Year Built
year_built.original: Year of original construction, as a four-digit number.
year_built.description: Extract the year of original construction as a four-digit year.

year_renovated.name: Year Renovated
year_renovated.original: Year of the latest renovation, if stated. null otherwise.
year_renovated.description: Extract the year of the latest renovation if stated. Return null otherwise.

building_type.name: Building Type
building_type.original: Style of construction as the OM names it, e.g. Garden, Mid-Rise.
building_type.description: Extract the style of construction as the OM names it, e.g. Garden, Mid-Rise. Return the name as text.

number_of_buildings.name: Number of Buildings
number_of_buildings.original: Count of residential buildings, as a number.
number_of_buildings.description: Extract the count of residential buildings as a number. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

stories.name: Stories
stories.original: Number of stories as the OM states it. Keep the OM's wording if it gives a range, e.g. '2 & 3'.
stories.description: Extract the number of stories as the OM states it. Return the OM's wording if it gives a range, e.g. '2 & 3'.

rentable_sf.name: Rentable Square Feet
rentable_sf.original: Total rentable square footage, as a number.
rentable_sf.description: Extract the total rentable square footage as a number. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

average_unit_sf.name: Average Unit Size (SF)
average_unit_sf.original: Average unit size in square feet, as a number. Use the OM's figure if given, otherwise rentable SF divided by units, rounded to the nearest whole number.
average_unit_sf.description: Extract the average unit size in square feet as a number. Use the OM's figure if given; otherwise calculate rentable square footage divided by units and round to the nearest whole number. Use current figures, not projections.

site_acres.name: Site Area (acres)
site_acres.original: Land area in acres, as a number.
site_acres.description: Extract the land area in acres as a number. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

parking_spaces.name: Parking Spaces
parking_spaces.original: Total parking spaces, as a number.
parking_spaces.description: Extract the total number of parking spaces as a number. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

parking_ratio.name: Parking Ratio
parking_ratio.original: Parking spaces per unit, as a number, e.g. 1.41.
parking_ratio.description: Extract parking spaces per unit as a number, e.g. 1.41. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

asking_price.name: Asking Price
asking_price.original: Quoted asking price as a number. null if the OM is unpriced.
asking_price.description: Extract the quoted asking price as a number. Return null if the OM is unpriced. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

price_per_unit.name: Price per Unit
price_per_unit.original: Asking price divided by units, rounded to the nearest whole number. null if the OM is unpriced.
price_per_unit.description: Extract price per unit as the asking price divided by the total number of units, rounded to the nearest whole number. Return null if the OM is unpriced.

asking_cap_rate.name: Asking Cap Rate
asking_cap_rate.original: Quoted cap rate as a percentage number, e.g. 5.25 for 5.25%. null if not stated.
asking_cap_rate.description: Extract the quoted asking cap rate as a percentage number, e.g. 5.25 for 5.25%. Return null if not stated. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

occupancy_pct.name: Current Occupancy
occupancy_pct.original: The current leased or occupied percentage the OM states for the property as of its rent roll date, as a number, e.g. 71 for '71% leased'. Not a proforma or economic occupancy assumption. null if not stated.
occupancy_pct.description: Extract the current leased or occupied percentage the OM states for the property as of its rent roll date, as a number, e.g. 71 for '71% leased'. Do not use a pro forma or economic occupancy assumption. Return null if not stated.

average_in_place_rent.name: Average In-Place Rent
average_in_place_rent.original: Average in-place effective rent per unit per month that the OM reports for the property itself, as a number. This is distinct from market rent and from comparable properties. null if not stated.
average_in_place_rent.description: Extract the average in-place effective rent per unit per month that the OM reports for the property itself, as a number. Do not use market rent or rents for comparable properties. Return null if not stated. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

market_rent.name: Market Rent
market_rent.original: Average market rent per unit per month the OM quotes for the property, as a number, e.g. from the unit mix summary.
market_rent.description: Extract the average market rent per unit per month the OM quotes for the property, as a number, e.g. from the unit mix summary. Do not substitute rents for comparable properties. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

market_rent_psf.name: Market Rent per SF
market_rent_psf.original: Market rent per square foot per month as a number, e.g. 2.23.
market_rent_psf.description: Extract market rent per square foot per month as a number, e.g. 2.23. Use the figure presented as current, not a projection.

unit_types.name: Unit Types
unit_types.original: List of the floor plan or unit type names in the unit mix table, in the order shown, e.g. ['A1', 'A2', 'B1']. Empty list if there is no unit mix table.
unit_types.description: Extract the floor plan or unit type names from the unit mix table as a list of text values, in the order shown, e.g. ['A1', 'A2', 'B1']. Return an empty list if there is no unit mix table.

noi_t12.name: Trailing 12 NOI
noi_t12.original: Trailing twelve month net operating income as a number, if the OM gives one. null otherwise.
noi_t12.description: Extract trailing twelve month net operating income as a number, if the OM gives one. Return null otherwise. Use the trailing twelve month figure, not a projection.

noi_proforma.name: Pro Forma NOI
noi_proforma.original: Year-one or pro forma net operating income as a number, if the OM gives one. null otherwise.
noi_proforma.description: Extract year-one or pro forma net operating income as a number, if the OM gives one. Return null otherwise.
